_doc: [onboard] The first-minutes story objectives (story/objectives.gd, ui/objective_card.gd). One at a time, in order, each with a one-line why (desc). brief.lines: WREN's 2-4 lines right after the intro (why Lumi cleans). Objective fields: text (title), desc (the why), hint (shown instead of desc until wait_flag is set), type stat|robot|zone|hub_level|flag|core, key, target (absolute: lifetime stats), hex (true: outline the target hex on the ground with its % cleaned), lines (WREN, when the objective starts). Data stays English; tr() at display.

lines: Your pod's dead, Lumi, and so is the relay. But the old base recycler still works.
Junk pressed into cubes powers it. Power rebuilds the base and builds you robot helpers.
And every bit of green you bring back charges your Bloom Core. Fill it, and you can call the Cradle.
Three bales should wake the base. Let's start there.

objectives.desc: Cubes feed the recycler. Its power wakes the base.
Clean ground is where green can grow again.
A helper keeps cleaning while you work.
lines: The base has power! Enough to build you a helper. Try the Bots tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: Press B and paint the hexes it should clean.
It carries bales to the scale for you.
Living green charges your Bloom Core.
objectives.hint: Keep clearing ground. WREN is listening for seeds.

objectives.desc: A bigger base runs more robots.
lines: The hub can grow now. Rebuild it from the Hub tab at the workbench.
